snippet.title: Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition for Nintendo Switch™ 2 | Announcement Trailer | Cities: Skylines
snippet.description:
We are also super happy to announce that we are releasing Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition for Nintendo Switch™ 2! Players who already own the Cities: Skylines – Nintendo Switch™ Edition will also receive a 70% loyalty discount when purchasing the Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition.

Build, manage, and expand the city of your dreams in Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition, the award-winning city-building game optimized for Nintendo Switch 2 with 10 included DLC expansions and content packs. 

https://pdxint.at/ExpandedEdition
